locations.title: Lumble The Lucky
locations.description:
Speak with him to play a game of dice.

After depleting Lumble's 16 rosaries (you get 4 for each win, and lose 4 for each loss), he'll reward you with [Magnetite Dice](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479309). It can be looted from his body in Act 2. If not picked up already, they can also be purchased from [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) in Act 3.

_Tip: After rolling the dice for ~5 seconds, the dice glimmer for a few frames. Throwing the dice in this window guarantees a winning roll, wherein Hornet makes a grunt as an indicator. Otherwise, win/lose is up to chance._

locations.title: Pinstress
locations.description:

locations.title: Arcane Egg
locations.description:
At the end of a long platforming sequence filled with spikes.

_An artefact almost impossibly old, marked inside with many fine etchings. Most are indecipherable._

_"...No will... No self... Shade..."_

locations.title: Bone Scroll
locations.description:
Held by a corpse found when swimming all the way to the right in the [secret room.](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478666)

_Faded parchment containing the last words of a lost pilgrim._

_"-ter I die here in the damp dark than join those poor sods, trapped to stumble, aimless and empty, until their limbs fall to dust."_

locations.title: Bone Scroll
locations.description:
**Required:** [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971)

_Signed parchment containing a pilgrim’s scrawl._  

_"My dear companions, all are gone now, devoured, scorched, fallen to exhaustion, or even worse seduced by the Haunting."_

locations.title: Bone Scroll
locations.description:
At the end of a tunnel behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478552).

_Filthy rag, marked with the scrawl of an Underworker._

_"So much suffering. Are we truly chosen, or have we sinned unknowing, and now are punished for it?"_

locations.title: Bone Scroll
locations.description:
At the very top of a platforming challenge. You'll need a fair bit of silk!

Crumpled parchment containing the prayer of a Burning Bug.

"Hail to your heat! O glorious flame. You who builds and breaks us. Sear our shells. Char them black. That we may rise to join you, wreathed in bright and blazing joy."

locations.title: Choral Commandment
locations.description:
On a high-up ledge.

_Decree of the Citadel, dirty and worn._

_"Full Chamber to the kingdom of the White Wyrm. Claim the Weaver, in half part. Last of their line. Sensed strong with Silk._

_Resistance anticipated. Quell with rune cage."_

locations.title: Choral Commandment
locations.description:
_Surgeon's orders._

_"Devout has succumbed during Silk suture. Refuses to revive. Sin committed. Permit no rites._

_Husk marked for cremation. Retrieve dregs."_

locations.title: Choral Commandment
locations.description:
At the end of a room above the [Hidden Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480039), easiest to reach via [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288).

_Tattered decree of the Citadel._

_"Bug of voice grown hoarse or shell fallen frail, you have been selected for duty most sacred._

_Become our light, our guide in darkness, that others worthy may climb to join the holy song"_

locations.title: Choral Commandment
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [The Lost Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479244) Wish

Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 180 Rosaries

_Last edict of the Conductors._

_"And lo, is eternity sustained. By Architect's claw, we welcome that final form, of dial and rotor, and soul gladly given._

_The perfect, unfaltering voice."_

At the top of the [Skull Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477968), not initially accessible.  Must traverse to the bottom, trigger an explosion and fight several waves of small enemies.  After the final wave, the lava starts to erupt and you must parkour back to the entrance.  The lava creates an updraft to reach your reward.

CAUTION: Near the top of the parkour, there is a path to the right and the left.  The left leads to the entrance.  Don't get trapped in the right-hand path.

On a high-up ledge.

_Words of a Weaver from the nest beneath Bone Bottom._

_"Hide her deep, the despised child, our shame shown in shell of iron. She is a wish cast vain, divinity mimicked in form too frail."_

locations.title: Rune Harp
locations.description:
At the end of the path beneath the [Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479055). Equip [Silkspeed Anklets](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478216) and drink [Flea Brew](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478025), then run through the room above to reach it.

_Plea of a Weaver from the furthest edge of Pharloom._

_"Flee, sisters. Flee until your strength exhausts, so far you may escape at last her silken sight._

_To start anew, to sustain, free of web and service eternal."_

locations.title: Rune Harp
locations.description:
Where Conductor Ballador would be in Act 3.

_Last words of the Weavers._

_"Sisters, spiders, the burden is passed. These simple bugs shall bear it full. Never to cease. Never to Silence_

_We shall die, and wait, and pray, that one may come of silken strength enough to weave us free."_

In a secret room that's easiest to reach when using the [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971) and floating down from above.

_Carving of Camora, Weaver of healing. A prayer is etched upon it._

_"Weaver, heal my sons, their fearful hearts, their limbs that shake at the clumb to come. We pray, gift but a glimmer of your strength, that when we stand before your divinity, you see bugs shed free of fear"_

locations.title: Weaver Effigy

_"Blessed Weaver, lady of grace, you who see our sin, our frail shells, our voices weak, and still offer your protection. How great your mind to care so much for ones so lowly."_

locations.title: Weaver Effigy

_Carving of Atla, Weaver of time. A prayer is etched upon it._

_"By grace of your example, and our history held full in mind, our song is yours, as your name is sacred. Weaver Atla, may you be praised eternal."_

locations.description: In the maze. Climb one level above the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479844), then jump over the spinning blades to your left to find it.

locations.title: Shell Shards
locations.description: At the end of a corridor entered from the eastern side.

locations.title: Shell Shards
locations.description: Behind a [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480944)

locations.title: Shell Shards
locations.description: On a ledge reached via Clawline.

locations.title: Shell Shards
locations.description: Hit the explosive rock to reveal them.

locations.title: Shell Shards
locations.description: West of a breakable wall.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: At the very top of the tower. Hit this [Lever](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480435) a few times and use the [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971) to reach it.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: Does not appear in Steel Soul mode.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: At the bottom of a spiky pit, guarded by two Snitchflies.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description:
At the top of a secret passage behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478656).

_Note: You'll be attacked by a Vaultkeeper after collecting it._

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: Partially hidden by a shelf at the eastern end of the room.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: In a secret room, reached by walking through the wall at the eastern edge of the dining room and climbing up through a few tunnels.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: On top of some ledges behind a [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478915).

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: Given to you by [Styx](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478266) when you die.

locations.title: Silkeater
locations.description: At the end of a tunnel beneath the [Breakable Floor](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479934). Look for a lever, then follow the tunnel down towards the steam and continue to the left.

locations.title: Swift Step
locations.description:
**Effect:** Sprint at blinding speed, beyond one's natural limits.

_Tip: You can press the sprint button while in the air to gain distance quickly._

locations.title: Drifter's Cloak
locations.description:
Complete [Flexile Spines](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477964) Wish

**Effect:** Ride strong winds and Glide

locations.title: Cling Grip
locations.description: **Effect:** Wall-jump

locations.title: Needolin
locations.description:
**Required:**  Defeat [Widow](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478138)

**Effect:** Play songs that can open special Needolin Doors, reveal secret lore, and make enemies / NPCs sing.

locations.title: Needle Strike
locations.description: **Effect:** Charged attack

locations.title: Clawline
locations.description: **Effect:** Fling needle as a harpoon with silk

locations.title: Faydown Cloak
locations.description:
**Requires:** [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199) & [Clawline](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478714)

**Effect:** Double Jump & Immunity to Freezing

locations.title: Beastling Call
locations.description:
Defeat [Bell Eater](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479264) in Act 3.

**Effect:** Summon beastlings from any location - will teleport to the last used Bellway Station

locations.title: Silk Soar
locations.description:
[ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260)

**Effect:** Fling upwards

locations.title: Elegy of the Deep
locations.description: Act 3 - Complete [Spell Seeker](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479385)

locations.title: Sylphsong
locations.description:
**Required:** Unlock a total of 32 tool slots via Memory Lockets and acquiring new Crests, then talk to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228).

_Note: Silk Skill slots count towards the total, but unlocking slots on the Hunter crest does not._

**Effect:** Silk will regenerate while resting at a bench

locations.title: Crest of Beast
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Chapel of the Beast](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478018)

**Slots:**
- 1 Silk Skill
- 2 Red
- 2 Yellow

locations.title: Crest of Reaper
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat the ambush in the [Chapel of the Reaper](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478155) and climb to the top.

**Slots:**
- 1 Silk Skill
- 2 Red
- 2 Blue
- 2 Yellow

locations.title: Crest of Wanderer
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Chapel of the Wanderer](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478239)

**Slots:**
- 1 Silk Skill
- 1 Red
- 2 Blue
- 3 Yellow

locations.title: Crest of Architect
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Chapel of the Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478743)

**Slots:**
- 0 Silk Skills
- 3 Red
- 2 Blue
- 2 Yellow

locations.title: Crest of Witch
locations.description:
**Required:**
- Take [Twisted Bud](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478783) to [Greyroot](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478172)
- Complete [Rite of Rebirth](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478792) Wish
- Complete [Infestation Operation](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478814) Wish

**Slots:**
- 1 Silk Skill
- 2 Red
- 3 Blue

locations.title: Crest of Shaman
locations.description:
[ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260)

In a tunnel above the [Lore Tablet](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479269), [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288)  required

**Slots:**
- 3 Silk Skill Slots
- 2 Blue

locations.title: Silkspear
locations.description:
**Effect:** Attack by throwing the needle forward. Silk will be expended.

_Tip: You can use this ability to release the [Bell Beast](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477879)._

locations.title: Thread Storm
locations.description:
**Effect:** Attack by whipping a storm of Silk around

_Tip: Rapidly tap the button to extend the time of the attack and do more damage._

locations.title: Cross Stitch
locations.description:
Defeat [Phantom](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478370)

**Effect:** Bind Silk around the needle to deflect enemy attacks and instantly strike back

locations.title: Rune Rage
locations.description:
Reward for defeating [First Sinner](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479023).

**Effect:** Weaves runes of blazing Silk upon enemies.

locations.title: Sharpdart
locations.description: **Effect:** Pierce through enemies + brief invincibility

locations.title: Pale Nails
locations.description:
[ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260)

**Required:** [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288)

**Effect:** Homing Projectiles

locations.title: Magnetite Brooch
locations.description:
Can be bought from [Pebb](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477837) for 120 rosaries

In [Act 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260), the item can be bought from [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522)

**Effect:** Any loose rosaries will be pulled toward the wearer

locations.title: Shard Pendant
locations.description: **Effect:** Collect more shell shards from defeated creatures

locations.title: Compass
locations.description: Sold by [Shakra](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477850) for 70 rosaries

locations.title: Straight Pin
locations.description:
On the upper level of [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477898)'s cell.

_Light throwing tool, designed for rapid attacks._

locations.title: Sting Shard
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 140 Rosaries + 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal)

**Effect:** Stabbing trap

locations.title: Magma Bell
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 110 Rosaries, 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal)

**Effect:** Reduces the damage taken from flame and magma

locations.title: Warding Bell
locations.description: **Effect:** Shield while healing

locations.title: Weighted Belt
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Mort](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477946) for 160 Rosaries

**Effect:** Gives you more time to recover after taking damage and reduces knockback

locations.title: Flintslate
locations.description: **Effect:** Sharpening slate made from cut and polished Flintgem. Temporarily super-heats the needle's blade, imbuing each slash with flame and increasing leathality.

locations.title: Flea Brew
locations.description:
Complete [The Lost Fleas](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477857) Wish and talk to [Grishkin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478023)

**Effect:** Temporarily increases the speed of movement and attacks

locations.title: Threefold Pin
locations.description:
In the [Secret Room](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478651), entered by walking through the wall.

**Effect:** Set of throwing blades

locations.title: Longpin
locations.description:
In a secret room behind a Wood Wasp nest.

**Effect:** Pierces tough shells

locations.title: Silkspeed Anklets
locations.description:
**Required:** [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199), [Swift Step](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477915) - dash across the room to reveal it.

**Effect:** Increases sprinting speed, consumes Silk

locations.title: Druid's Eye
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Berry Picking](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477876) Wish

**Effect:** Upon taking damage, silk is formed

Can be upgraded to [Druid's Eyes](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480493).

locations.title: Pollip Pouch
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Rite of the Pollip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478173) Wish

**Effect:** Applies venom to equipped Tools

locations.title: Barbed Bracelet
locations.description: **Effect:** Increases damage taken, but also increases damage dealt by the needle

locations.title: Multibinder
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [My Missing Courier](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478207)

 Can be purchased from [Frey](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478203) for 880 Rosaries

**Effect:** Extends the act of binding, but increases its healing effect

locations.title: Tacks
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Roach Guts](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478356) Wish

**Effect:** Leaves spikes on the ground, damaging enemies that step on them.

_Note: In Act 3, it will appear on the floor inside the hut._

locations.title: Plasmium Phial
locations.description:
Complete [Alchemist's Assistant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478482) Wish

**Effect:** Grants a temporary health boost that disappears upon sitting on a bench, just like Lifeblood

_Tip: With the [Architect Crest](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478745), this can be used to get 9 Plasmium Masks at once which triggers Plasmium Overdose, a state wherein you get passive health regeneration, granting essentially infinite health. This resets after dying, sitting on a bench, and fast traveling._

locations.title: Thief's Mark
locations.description:
Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 350 Rosaries

**Effect:** Enemies drop more Rosaries, but you lose some Rosaries when taking damage

locations.title: Delver's Drill
locations.description: **Effect:** Downward drill attack. Deals heavy damage.

locations.title: Curveclaw
locations.description:
Sold by [Mottled Skarr](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478602) for 140 Rosaries

**Effect:** Throwing weapon

In Act 3, it can be found [**here**](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479726).

locations.title: Fractured Mask
locations.description:
Sold by [Mottled Skarr](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478602) for 260 Rosaries, or found on the ground here later in the game.

**Effect:** Shields against critical damage, but shatters on impact. Repaired by resting at a bench.

locations.title: Claw Mirror
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478690)

**Effect:** Emits a flash that damages surrounding enemies

locations.title: Cogwork Wheel
locations.description:
Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 360 Rosaries and 1 Craftmetal

**Effect:** Throws a buzzsaw on the ground which can climb walls and loop back around, potentially hitting an enemy multiple times

locations.title: Sawtooth Circlet
locations.description:
Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 230 Rosaries and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal)

**Effect:** Using the Drifter's Cloak or Faydown Cloak damages surrounding enemies

locations.title: Scuttlebrace
locations.description:
Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 140 Rosaries and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal)

**Effect:** Dodge backwards

locations.title: Silkshot (Twelfth Architect)
locations.description:
Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 130 Rosaries + 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) + [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457)

**Effect:** Triple projectile attack, uses Shell Shards and Silk

locations.title: Quick Sling
locations.description:
In a secret area above two [Breakable Ceilings](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478847).

**Effect:** Throws tools twice with a single use (uses twice as much ammo)

locations.title: Ascendant's Grip
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 350 Rosaries

**Effect:** Cling to walls indefinitely

locations.title: Spool Extender
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 720 Rosaries


**Effect:** Allows the storing of additional Silk

locations.title: Cogfly
locations.description:
**Required:** 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal)

**Effect:** Winged cogwork companion that will seek nearby enemies and attack

locations.title: Rosary Cannon
locations.description:
Behind a breakable wall in the [Rosary Storage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478911) - Simple Key required

**Effect:** Shoots rosaries

locations.title: Memory Crystal
locations.description:
Inside a large shard of ice at the end of a tunnel.

**Effect:** When you take damage, leave an ice clone behind that shoots out spikes when hit by an enemy.

locations.title: Pimpillo
locations.description:
Interact with the table.

**Required:** [Cling Grip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478189), [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) (x1)

**Effect:** Grenade. Explodes on impact or a few seconds after throwing.

locations.title: Weavelight
locations.description:
Inside a decoration on the ceiling of the rooftop where you fight [Moss Mother x2](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478440)


**Effect:** Increases the speed of Silk regeneration.

locations.title: Snare Setter
locations.description:
[Silk and Soul](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479243) Wish

**Required:** [Faydown Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479103)

**Effect:** Landmine

locations.title: Dead Bug's Purse
locations.description:
Held by a corpse in a small room guarded by 2 Gromlings.

**Effect:** Retain some rosaries upon defeat.

Play the needolin here for more lore.

locations.title: Voltvessels
locations.description: **Effect:** When thrown, forms an electrical orb

locations.title: Wreath of Purity
locations.description: **Effect:** Repel Muckmaggots and maggot-based attacks for ~6.5 seconds before breaking. Can be repaired at a bench.

locations.title: Wispfire Lantern
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Father of the Flame](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479155)

**Effect:** Uses a slight amount of silk to spawn wisps that attack enemies

locations.title: Injector Band
locations.description: **Effect:** Increases the speed of binding

locations.title: Snitch Pick
locations.description:
Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 740 Rosaries

**Effect:** Harpoon into enemies to get Rosaries and Shell Shards

locations.title: Volt Filament
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Voltvyrm](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479223)

**Effect:** Electric charge on Silk Skills

locations.title: Conchcutter
locations.description:
Found almost immediately after entering the Coral Tower.

**Effect:** Throwable weapon, can also ricochet from surfaces

locations.title: Longclaw
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Broodfeast](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478865) Wish

**Effect:** Increases the range of needle

locations.title: Throwing Ring
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [Trail's End](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479237) Wish

**Effect:** Rebounds between enemies and hard surfaces

locations.title: Spider Strings
locations.description:
**Required:** Complete [The Lost Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479244) Wish

Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 320 Rosaries

**Effect:** Expands the range of the [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199), and makes Needolin dialogue / lore appear and cycle faster.

locations.title: Reserve Bind
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Second Sentinel](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479253)

**Effect:** Holds a Bind's worth of silk that can be used even when out of silk. Refills at benches.

locations.title: Magnetite Dice
locations.description:
Required: Beat [Lumble The Lucky](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478519) at dice enough times, or return to this spot after visiting the Choral Chambers.

**Effect:** Chance to negate an attack


**Note:** Can also be bought from [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 300 Rosaries in [ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260)

locations.title: Silkshot (Forge Daughter)
locations.description:
Purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 240 Rosaries + 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) + [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457). May be unavailable after defeating [Forebrothers Signis & Gron](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478831).

**Effect:** Burst projectile attack

locations.title: Dark Mirror / Claw Mirrors
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Tormented Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479377)

Upgraded version of the [Claw Mirror](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478691). Not required for 100% completion.

**Effect:** While binding, emits a more powerful blast that damages surrounding enemies

locations.title: Egg of Flealia
locations.description:
Find every Lost Flea in Pharloom

**Effect:** Decreases the cost of Silk Skills while health is full

locations.title: Pin Badge
locations.description:
**Required:** Defeat [Pinstress](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479464) in Act 3

**Effect:** Reduces charge time of Needle Strike

locations.title: Silkshot (Weaver)
locations.description:
Bring the [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457) and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) to the table near the [Bench](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478382) to create it.

**Effect:** Uses shell canisters and the wielder's own Silk to fire.

locations.title: Shell Satchel
locations.description:
**Steel Soul mode only!**

**Effect:** Increases the quantity of crafted tools.

locations.title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 180 Rosaries

**Effect:** Increases tool damage

_Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

locations.title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
locations.description:
Can be purchased from [Mort](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477946) for 220 Rosaries

**Effect:** Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried

_Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

locations.title: Crest of Hunter Upgrade 1
locations.description:
**Required:** Speak to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228) and allow the Insight.

**Effect:** Hitting enemies generates Focus. Fill the focus bar to deal more damage.

**Slots:**
- 2 Red
- 2 Blue
- 2 Yellow

locations.title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
locations.description:
Complete [Loddie's](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478251) first challenge by hitting the target 15 times, or find it here in [Act 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260).

**Effect:** Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried

_Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

locations.title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
locations.description:
Complete [Crawbug Clearing](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478208) Wish

**Effect:** Increases tool damage

_Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

locations.title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
locations.description:
Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 700 Rosaries

**Effect:** Increases tool damage

_Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

locations.title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
locations.description:

locations.title: Curvesickle

**Required:** [Curveclaw](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478604) - hit each of the four targets with one thrown Curveclaw, then give the Curveclaw to the Skarr Rogue that appears. Upon resting at a bench and returning to the area, the Curvesickle will be waiting for you.

_This upgrade is not a requirement for 100% completion._

    - Complete the [Pinmaster's Oil](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478211) Wish
- Hivesteel Needle
    - Complete the [Great Taste of Pharloom](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478889) Wish and hand over 450 Rosaries
- Pale Steel Needle
    - Complete the [Ecstasy of the End](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479444) Wish and hand over 680 Rosaries

_Fully upgrading your weapon is a requirement for 100% completion._

To get rid of the parasite - talk to [Yarnaby](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478268) and complete the [Infestation Operation](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478814) Wish.

**Required:** Defeat [Lace](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479088), find 25 Fleas and move the Flea Caravan to [Fleatopia](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479143), complete the [Trail's End](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479237) Wish, and talk to [Caretaker](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478601). You may also need to unlock the [Bellhome](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479175) and have visited Whiteward.

**Collect:**
- [Maiden's Soul](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479256)
- [Hermit's Soul](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479258)
- [Seeker's Soul](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478863)
- [Snare Setter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479071)

**Reward:**
- [Soul Snare](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260) Objective

locations.title: Final Audience
locations.description:
**Required:**
- Activate the [Second Sentinel](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478616)
- Learn the Conductor's Melody
- Complete the wish Building Up Songclave and at least one other Songclave wish
- Watch any two of his fights (or one after getting the Everbloom in Act 3). 
  - The fights happen in the following areas:
    - [Second Sentinel - Second Encounter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480401)
    - [Second Sentinel - Third Encounter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480402)
    - [Second Sentinel - Fourth Encounter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480991)

- [Reserve Bind](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479254)

locations.title: Creepy Surprise
locations.description: Before killing [Widow](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478138), quit the game (or just return to the main menu) after resting on the [Bench](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476884) in the middle of Bellhart. When you resume playing, Hornet will be dangling from a web like the rest of the townsfolk.

locations.title: A Hard Day's Work
locations.description: Run on the treadmill next to [Loam](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478562) for some time to receive a generous salary, courtesy of the Citadel - one rosary bead!

locations.title: Parasite... Good?
locations.description:
If you're captured by a cage-carrying Wardenfly while [cursed](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478792), you won't be sent to the [usual spot](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478462).

Instead, the parasite will lash out, setting Hornet free and killing the would-be kidnapper.

locations.title: Free Quill!
locations.description:
If you avoid purchasing a quill from [Shakra](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477852), a unique red one can be collected here, near [Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478690)'s boss room - though defeating him is not a requirement.

Similarly, a unique purple quill can be found here in Act 3.

The quill you collect will determine the icon of the Map & Quill in the inventory screen.

locations.title: Hope for Verdania
locations.description:
Some time after defeating the [Clover Dancers](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479427), greenery will begin to sprout from their final resting places.

It may take time, but it seems there's hope for the old kingdom yet.

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
Take a right when you reach the bottom of the elevator, climb the ledges, and hit a lever to reach it.

_At the seventh bell toll, send:_

_Thirty measures, four beats Smokerock,_

_Eight beats Sweetsmelt,_

_Mark of fealty, all workers._

_At the ninth bell toll, send:_

_Twenty measures, two beats Smokerock,_

_Seven beats Sweetsmelt,_

_Mark of fealty, all workers._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_In the air. The water. Everywhere._

_Inside their shells. Twisted inside. Guts._

_Tightest around heart. Pulsing rhythm._

_Sick. Alive. Dead?_

_Something worse._

_Deeper. Must look deeper._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_-ilgrim_

_You who have held tight to faith have been carried far._

_This station shall offer brief rest to those devout._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Pilgrim_

_This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._

_May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Litany of the Worker_

_May we catch the dregs and never tire,_

_May we clean the dregs and never hunger,_

_May we spool the dregs and never falter._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Pilgrim_

_This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._

_May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_This low, her gaze escaped._

_Prepare, sisters. Weave hope anew._

_That we might break free this accursed web born of our naive foundation._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Pilgrim_

_You are blessed to walk the foundations of Pharloom._

_Humble yourself before the shells of those who gave their lives to hold our kingdom's weight._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Weaver of Pharloom._

_By grace you warded. By thread you healed._

_For your favour, eternal, we offer our song._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_On the eighth harvest, send:_

_Fifty measures, nine beats dregthread, spooled,_

_Fourteen measures dregthread, twined,_

_Oath of fealty, all workers._

_On the twelfth harvest, send:_

_Forty measures dregthread, spooled,_

_Two beats fine thread, twined,_

_Oath of fealty, all workers._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Pilgrim_

_Spare a song for those who lay here silent._

_By strength abandoned they fell before the final ascent._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Pilgrim_

_Accept the judgement of the rise beyond,_

_That all who stand at Pharloom's holy crest prove pure of will and want._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Sister, spider, sat between salt and stone,_

_Build those tools of brilliant mind imagined,_

_Aid us when our Silk has waned._

locations.title: Needolin Lore
locations.description:
Use the [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199) to see the final thoughts of Alchemist Zylotol's first assistant.

_The buds must grow..._

_Only a little... Only a spark..._

_To our dead lands... life..._

_Too dark..._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
In a room behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478534)

_Bug born of Pharloom. You have been chosen._

_May our Citadel's holy gilding harden your soft shell._

_Stand eternal as our arbiter, that no bug bearing sin shall step within our sacred halls._

locations.title: Confession Stand
locations.description:
Insert 25 Rosaries for lore. On the other side, attack some gears to break the machine and receive different dialogue.

_Speak now. Thy confession will be heard._

_**Hornet:** ..._

_You have confessed a sin most grave and must by works cleanse yourself._

_Return to your task and work off-cycle, neither eating nor supping until new-cycle begins._

_By the grace of Pharloom eternal may you never tire. Toil, and be forgiven._

---

Alternative dialogue if the machine is broken on the other side:

_Speak... ... confession..._

_**Hornet:** ..._

_You... ... sin... ... cleanse..._

_Return... ... work... ... begins...._

_... Pharloom... ... never... ... forgiven._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Great bugs! You who weep as your kingdom fades, join me upon the Stage._

_Together, we shall enflame the passion of Pharloom!_

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Here is established, by holy consent of the Conductors, The Memorium of Pharloom._

_What Is Remembered Is Never Lost._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_O, great land whose flame doth falter!_

_Whose choir, conductors, all doth fail,_

_Observe! Take heart! That spark still burning,_

_Yon butterfly of crimson grace,_

_All bells shall peal, and voices raise,_

_When brave Trobbio steps, at last, upon the stage!_

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Hate for their light. Hate for their pins. For their waste poured thick and endless._

_Fill your hearts with hate, for power has now been claimed, and with it we shall punish._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Oath of the Whiteward_

_While song must be sung, none may falter._

_Infirmity. Sickness. Death._

_All are banished from our Citadel._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Sister, spider, if seeking commune with the creature atop this mount, take the climb above as a test, a challenge beyond even our setting._

_Upon that summit gained, and creature hailed, know it shall choose what gift to grant, with death as likely as insight._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Their shells are ours. Their souls are ours._

_Our hate is forever._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Penitent, Eight of the Twelfth._

_Guilty of the sin of irreverence._

_Penance by chaining._

_Absolution granted after death._

_Penitent, Second of the Fourth._

_Guilty of the sin of dissonance._

_Penance by silencing._

_Absolution granted after death._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Penitent, Fourth of the Fourth._

_Guilty of the sins of infirmity, sickness._

_Penance by swallowing._

_Absolution granted after death._

_Penitent, Twelfth of the First._

_Guilty of an unnamed sin._

_Penance by casting._

_Absolution not granted._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
**Note: Will disappear after breaking all of the bindings outside the cell.**

_Penitent, First of the First._

_Guilty of the sin of apostasy._

_Penance by constriction._

_Absolution denied._

locations.title: Lore

_A rune depicting paths away from Pharloom._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Due to unacceptably high injury and unsanctioned deaths, Ventrica travel shall henceforth be denied to all._

_For Pharloom eternal, a bug who serves must never die._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, frail with age._

_Tracked and taken in Sandsea Waste._

_Seven Choristors, nine Envoys lost to task._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, mortally wounded._

_Tracked and taken in the Blackbarrens._

_Four Choristors, one Reed lost to task._

locations.title: Lore
locations.description:
_Weaver, in quarter part, last of their line, staked to service._

_Tracked and taken beneath the City of Steel._

_Eight Choristors, twelve Envoys lost to task._

locations.title: Lore Tablet
locations.description:
_Containment fails. Memory lost. Excise outer. Maintain inner._

_Shellwood stasis sustained - Remember._

_Marrowlands stasis critical - Remember._

_Verdanian environment exceeded - Destined to forget._

locations.title: Riddle Tablet
locations.description:
